patterns.note: Full-bleed, immersive photographic sections dominate the viewport, serving as both background and primary content for each project.
A single, large, fixed block of descriptive text overlays the initial sequence of full-bleed images, providing a studio introduction before project-specific details.
Background images transition vertically with a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls, while the main introductory text remains fixed in the viewport until it scrolls out.
Project titles and details appear at the bottom-left of the viewport, associated with each new full-bleed image section, while the 'Info' link and copyright notice remain sticky.
Text elements are consistently light (white or light grey) to ensure high contrast against the diverse and often dark photographic backgrounds.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-screen vertical scrolling mechanism where each scroll 'snap' reveals a new full-bleed background image, effectively creating a dynamic, image-driven portfolio experience.

A large, semi-transparent text block is positioned fixedly over the initial sequence of these full-bleed images, creating a subtle parallax effect as the background scrolls beneath it, enhancing depth and focus.

As each new full-bleed image section comes into view, associated project metadata (title, year, type, location) is revealed at the bottom left, while a global 'Info' link and copyright notice remain sticky at the bottom of the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized hero text (~3-4x body) with smaller, legible project details and navigation.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its immersive, full-screen image transitions combined with a fixed, large introductory text block that creates a unique parallax scrolling experience. It feels like dynamically flipping through a high-end design magazine, offering a highly engaging and visually rich portfolio presentation.
